h: Adekunle Gold praised for giving N250,000 each to first-class graduates
p: Adekunle Gold is drawing praise online after reportedly gifting N250,000 each to several first-class graduates. The singer is also in the news for a separate $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients.
more: Many commenters called it a rare gesture of encouragement for academic excellence.
It follows his sickle cell announcement earlier today.
